author: Unreal Engine
description:
Modern AECO and heritage documentation projects generate datasets spanning gigabytes to terabytes, exceeding traditional import limits. While proprietary cloud conversion services exist, they impose cost barriers and raise data sovereignty concerns for confidential projects. 

This session recorded at Unreal Fest Chicago 2026 presents three open source pipelines for processing and streaming massive 3D datasets into Unreal Engine at runtime. 

Firstly, we cover photogrammetry mesh processing using a Blender-based workflow that converts high-resolution scans into optimized 3D Tiles.This approach leverages adaptive octree tiling and UV-based texture baking to achieve up to 62% size reduction on larger models. 

Second, we demonstrate a point cloud pipeline using Entwine, PDAL, and Blender to convert E57 and LAZ files into streamable 3D Tiles with proper LOD hierarchies.

title: From Scan to Stream: Open Pipelines for Large-Scale 3D in Unreal Engine  | Unreal Fest Chicago 2026

author: Unreal Engine
description:
Audio Insights is a suite of profiling and debugging tools for sound designers and audio developers in Unreal Engine. It was the #1 requested feature of the Unreal Audio Engine, and UE 5.8 marks its version 1.0 release. 

This session recorded at Unreal Fest Chicago 2026 gives an overview of the tool, explores all the ways to use it to visualize audio data, and suggests workflows to enhance sound design and debug efficiency. 

Watch for a demonstration of how, using several tabbed windows, Audio Insights can provide both visualizations and numerical values for current pitch, volume, and other parameter values for sources, audio buses, submixes, and more during live gameplay. We also look at how it displays information for PIE sessions in addition to stand-alone games on development platforms and consoles.

Find out more about Unreal Engine 5.8 here: unrealengine.com/news/unreal-engine-5-8-is-now-available
